validation_scope.raw: TOUS PRODUITS D'ALIMENTATION HUMAINE (PAR DES ESSAIS DE VALIDATION REALISES SUR UNE VASTE GAMME D’ALIMENTS, JUSQU’A 25 ET 375G), LES PREPARATIONS ET CEREALES POUR NOURRISSONS AVEC ET SANS PROBIOTIQUES AVEC LEURS INGREDIENTS (JUSQU’A 375G), LES PRODUITS CARNES ET A BASE DE VOLAILLE (JUSQU’A 375G), LES ŒUFS ET LES OVOPRODUITS (JUSQU’A 375G), LE CACAO ET LES PRODUITS AU CHOCOLAT (JUSQU’A 375G), LES PRODUITS D’ALIMENTATION POUR ANIMAUX DE COMPAGNIE ET LES PRODUITS D’ALIMENTATION ANIMALE (JUSQU’A 25G), ET LES ECHANTILLONS DE L'ENVIRONNEMENT DE PRODUCTION INDUSTRIELLE (JUSQU’A 25G) ALL HUMAN FOOD PRODUCTS (BY PERFORMING VALIDATION ASSAYS ON A BROAD RANGE OF FOODS, UP TO 25 AND 375G), INFANT FORMULA AND INFANT CEREALS WITH AND WITHOUT PROBIOTICS INCLUDING INGREDIENTS (UP TO 375G), MEAT AND POULTRY PRODUCTS (UP TO 375G), EGGS AND EGG PRODUCTS (UP TO 375G), COCOA AND CHOCOLATE PRODUCTS (UP TO 375G), PET FOOD PRODUCTS AND FEED PRODUCTS (UP TO 25G), AND INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION ENVIRONMENTAL SAMPLES

traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: Values recorded are from Table 7 (page 20-21), using the primary/canonical protocol per category as designated in the report: categories 1-2,5-7 use 'BPW with ISO 6887 specific rules (if required), Without FDRS' totals (the paired protocol favored per ISO 6887 additive rules); category 2 (Milk and dairy) uses the 'BPW with ISO 6887 specific rules, Without FDRS' total (93.5/100.0/96.8/0.0) rather than the 'With FDRS' variant (identical values in this case) or the BPW-only variants (which gave lower values, e.g. 87.9/93.9/90.5/0.0 without FDRS, 90.9/93.9/92.1/0.0 with FDRS) -- these alternates are noted here for completeness. Category 3 (Multicomponent) and 4 (Fishery) only had 'BPW without ISO 6887 specific rules' protocol tested (no ISO 6887 variant existed for these), so their Total rows were used directly. Category 6 (Pet food/animal feed) used the 'BPW with ISO 6887 specific rules, Without FDRS' Total (100.0/100.0/100.0/4.2) rather than the BPW-only variant (91.2/91.2/92.4/4.4). Category 8 (Cocoa/chocolate) only had the 'BPW without ISO 6887 specific rules' protocol (analysis by Microsept, extension study 2025), so its Total row was used. Overall 'All categories' summary rows at bottom of Table 7 were excluded per instructions. No Acceptability Limit applies to qualitative studies (field left null in quantitative section, which itself is null since method is qualitative).
